extracted.intended_audience: organizers, reporters, and authors (workshop speakers) preparing Oberwolfach Reports (OWR) extended abstracts
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and submitting 1–3 page extended abstracts (including references) of talks for publication in the Oberwolfach Reports series, including formatting, copyright/licensing, and submission checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extended abstract length
rubrics_metrics.description: OWR contain extended abstracts of 1-3 pages, including references, of the given talks during the meetings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep each report within 1–3 pages total (counting references). The extended-abstract format is the required element for each talk in an Oberwolfach Workshop/Mini-Workshop/Arbeitsgemeinschaft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content scope — report on state of research
rubrics_metrics.description: The aim is to report periodically upon the state of mathematical research, and to make these reports available to the mathematical community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should summarize results, open problems, and new developments in the particular field represented by the workshop; the reports should be suitable for informing the community about the current state of research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quotability and referencability
rubrics_metrics.description: As official documents, the OWR will be quotable and it will be possible to refer to results, open problems, and new developments in a particular field of mathematics represented in an Oberwolfach Workshop.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write reports so that claims, results and problems can be cited; include references and sufficient context for citation and later use by others.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the provided LaTeX template
rubrics_metrics.description: We strongly urge the reporter and the authors to use our latex template for OWR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors/reporters should use the official LaTeX template to ensure correct formatting and consistency with the series; the template is provided on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow formatting and editing guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: We should like to ask the organizers, the reporter and the authors to take a look at our guidelines concerning the format and the editing process of OWR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the OWR guidelines for detailed instructions on formatting, editing steps, and the editorial workflow; adherence to these guidelines is expected for submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the online diagnostics/check tool
rubrics_metrics.description: We also provide an online tool which can check your report for common errors before submitting it to us.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Run your report through the provided diagnostics tool to detect and correct common errors prior to submission, reducing back-and-forth during the editing process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preliminary labeling and final publication timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Note that the report will be labeled "preliminary" until we collected all reports of the quarter and published the book issue with final page numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand that individual reports may appear as 'preliminary' on the activity pages until the quarterly book issue is finalized; final pagination and labeling occur with the quarterly publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright of extended abstracts retained by authors
rubrics_metrics.description: Oberwolfach leaves the copyright of the extended abstracts to the authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors retain copyright in their individual extended abstracts and remain free to publish the results elsewhere; ensure any co-author agreements reflect this.

rubrics_metrics.name: License granted to MFO during registration
rubrics_metrics.description: During the registration process for the meeting, all participants are asked to grant a non-exclusive license to the MFO to publish their scientific contribution within the OWR in electronic and printed form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grant the requested non-exclusive license as part of registration to permit MFO to publish your abstract; this is compatible with retaining authors' copyright and does not block later publication elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: MFO copyright on OWR as a whole and publication rights
rubrics_metrics.description: The MFO holds the copyright on OWR as a whole and has the irrevocable right of publication and distribution, either in printed form or electronically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While authors retain copyright in their individual abstracts, MFO asserts copyright over the compiled publication (the OWR volume) and its right to publish/distribute that compilation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication formats, frequency and indexing
rubrics_metrics.description: The OWR are published quarterly as hard cover book series (ISSN print 1660-8933) as well as in electronic form (ISSN digital 1660-8941) in cooperation with EMS Press. OWR are indexed in zbMATH Open and Mathematical Reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions become part of a formally published, indexed series (quarterly, print and electronic), so authors should prepare material suitable for archival publication and indexing.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to access/locate and submit reports
rubrics_metrics.description: The reports of all Workshops, Mini-Workshops and Arbeitsgemeinschaften are freely available via the individual webpages of activities which can be found in the overview of activities. First, navigate to the list of meetings of the corresponding year, then browse through the titles and click on the link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To find existing reports or to follow submission procedures, navigate the year/meeting listings on the OWR site; follow the specific meeting's page for links to reports and submission instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact points for questions and library arrangements
rubrics_metrics.description: In case of further questions do not hesitate to contact us at reports@mfo.de. In case that your library is interested in an exchange arrangement ... please do not hesitate to contact our librarian.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use reports@mfo.de for submission/formatting queries and the librarian contact for subscription or exchange arrangements.
